title: Precious Communion
firstLine: Precious Communion: The feast of our dear Lord,

lines: Precious Communion: The feast of our dear Lord,
Shows forth the sacrifice He made;
Precious Communion: Each first day of the week,
The bread and cup bring to our mind
Precious Communion; We all remember Him
Who gave His life upon the cross,
And worship Him as Lord of lords
